notes.frame: Phosphor's envelope, cut so the frame's ends sit 32 units from the badge's centerline: 16 stay clear at regular, 8 in bold. The badge sits at the bottom right, so the flap keeps its whole V.
notes.drawing: phone-x's x (48 wide) at the bottom right, where envelope-check has its check.
notes.fill: envelope-fill with a white band 24 units round the badge, then the badge as a line, as bell-dot cuts the bell round its dot.
notes.duotone: The flap is tinted as in envelope-duotone.
